blog_title: Kubernetes 1.7: Security Hardening, Stateful Application Updates and Extensibility

spotlights.heading: The Network Policy API
spotlights.summary: The Network Policy API: is promoted to stable. Network policy, implemented through a network plug-in, allows users to set and enforce rules governing which pods can communicate with each other.

spotlights.heading: Node authorizer
spotlights.summary: Node authorizer: and admission control plugin are new additions that restrict kubelet’s access to secrets, pods and other objects based on its node.

spotlights.heading: Encryption for Secrets
spotlights.summary: Encryption for Secrets: , and other resources in etcd, is now available as alpha.

spotlights.heading: Kubelet TLS bootstrapping
spotlights.summary: Kubelet TLS bootstrapping: now supports client and server certificate rotation.

spotlights.heading: Audit logs
spotlights.summary: Audit logs: stored by the API server are now more customizable and extensible with support for event filtering and webhooks. They also provide richer data for system audit.

spotlights.heading: StatefulSet Updates
spotlights.summary: StatefulSet Updates: is a new beta feature in 1.7, allowing automated updates of stateful applications such as Kafka, Zookeeper and etcd, using a range of update strategies including rolling updates.

spotlights.heading: Local Storage
spotlights.summary: Local Storage: (alpha) was one of most frequently requested features for stateful applications. Users can now access local storage volumes through the standard PVC/PV interface and via StorageClasses in StatefulSets.

spotlights.heading: StorageOS Volume plugin
spotlights.summary: StorageOS Volume plugin: provides highly-available cluster-wide persistent volumes from local or attached node storage.

spotlights.heading: API aggregation
spotlights.summary: API aggregation: at runtime is the most powerful extensibility features in this release, allowing power users to add Kubernetes-style pre-built, 3rd party or user-created APIs to their cluster.

spotlights.heading: Container Runtime Interface
spotlights.summary: Container Runtime Interface: (CRI) has been enhanced with New RPC calls to retrieve container metrics from the runtime. [Validation tests for the CRI](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-node/cri-validation.md) have been published and Alpha integration with [containerd](http://containerd.io/), which supports basic pod lifecycle and image management is now ava

spotlights.heading: external admission controllers
spotlights.summary: external admission controllers: is introduced, providing two options for adding custom business logic to the API server for modifying objects as they are created and validating policy.

spotlights.heading: Policy-based Federated Resource Placement
spotlights.summary: Policy-based Federated Resource Placement: is introduced as Alpha providing placement policies for the federated clusters, based on custom requirements such as regulation, pricing or performance.
